smarthome.config.client.disable_in_world: Disable in-world displays if you have performance issues or problems with shaders.
smarthome.config.client.display_refresh_: How often in-world displays refresh in ticks. Lower values mean more frequent updates but can impact performance.
smarthome.config.server.database_path.to: Path to the database file, relative to the world folder.
smarthome.config.server.display_data_upd: How often in-world displays get sent new data ticks. Lower values mean more frequent updates for clients but can impact performance.
smarthome.config.server.drop_sensors_in_: Drop sensor updates in favor of TPS
If true, sensors data will not be updated if the server TPS is struggling. This means that some sensor data might be missing in favor of server performance.
smarthome.config.server.insert_sparse.to: If true, sensor data will be inserted in a sparse manner, skipping sensor readings that have no changes.
smarthome.config.server.min_sensor_tick_: Minimum allowed sensor tick rate in ticks. This is to prevent sensors from being spammed too often.
smarthome.config.server.sparse_tick_rate: When inserting sparse data, this defines the minimum tick rate between two identical sensor readings to still insert the data.
Size of the database task queue. Increase this if you have many sensors and tasks are getting backed up.
